exchanges: Ok so I need to vent a little. Our street is changing so fast, it feels like everyone is leaving at once and I don't know how to feel about it
That can be unsettling, especially when you've gotten used to the people around you. Who's leaving?

Well first Tomás next door, the Ruiz family, they've been there like 12 years. He told me yesterday over the fence they're moving to Halifax in the spring because his wife's parents are out there and getting older
Twelve years is a long time to be neighbours. It makes sense they'd want to be near family, but it's still a loss for you.
yeah. and the funny thing is my cousin is also named Tomás so whenever I say Tomás my husband goes 'which one'
That must lead to some confusing conversations at home.
lol constantly. Anyway the other side is the Haddads, they're staying thank god. Mrs Haddad has the most gorgeous garden, she babies her dahlias like they're grandchildren
A neighbour with a beautiful garden is a real perk.
her husband Samir is an electrician which has saved us SO many times, he fixed our panel last winter for basically nothing
That's a great neighbour to have, that kind of work is expensive.
Totally. Ok different topic, Sofia has her recital next month and she's been practicing the viola every night, the whole house hears it
Daily practice before a recital is a good sign she's taking it seriously.
she is! she's 13 and very serious about everything right now haha
Thirteen is a big age for finding the thing you care about.
My aunt Marisol is coming to the recital, she drives up from the city. She's a veterinarian so she always has like a million animal stories at dinner
That should make for an entertaining dinner after the recital.
and she always brings her dog which my husband pretends to hate
Sounds like he secretly loves the visits.
100%. so I talked to my cousin Tomás last night for the first time in ages
Oh nice, how's he doing?
good I think? he's out in Calgary now, moved there in August for a new job and he says it's already freezing lol
Prairie winters arrive early, so he's in for a long one.
he sent a picture of snow on his car in like October. I would die
That's early even for out there. Hopefully he's got a good winter coat.
The Ruiz kids are sad about moving, their youngest Mateo plays trumpet in the school band with Sofia
It's hard for kids to leave their friends and bands behind.
I'm thinking of throwing a little goodbye thing for them before they go
That's a kind idea. Something casual in the backyard could be nice.
yeah maybe a potluck. Mrs Haddad would bring her stuffed grape leaves which are unreal
A potluck makes it easy for everyone to contribute something they're proud of.
Oh wait, I said viola earlier, it's cello. Sofia plays cello. I always mix them up and she gets SO offended lol
Noted! I can see why she'd be offended, they're pretty different in size.
the thing is basically as big as her
Getting it to and from lessons must be quite the workout.
samir drives her sometimes when I can't, he has this huge van for work
That's really generous of him.
they've been so good to us honestly
It sounds like you've built a real community on your street.
My abuela Rosa lives with us too, did I mention that? She's 84
No, but that's lovely that she lives with you. How's she doing?
Mostly good, she loves sitting out front and gossiping with Mrs Haddad
Sounds like the two of them have a nice friendship.
they're both terrible gossips lol. they know everything about everyone
Every street needs a couple of people who keep track of the news.
the only thing is her diabetes means I have to watch what she eats at these potlucks, she sneaks desserts
Maybe bring a dessert you know is safe for her so she has something to enjoy.
good idea, I can do a sugar free flan
A flan would fit right in, and she might not even notice the difference.
haha she'll notice, she notices everything. Ok I'm gonna start a group chat for the potluck
Good luck with the planning, it sounds like it'll be a nice send-off.

questions.message: wait where did my cousin end up moving
what does my aunt do again, I forget
Sofia's recital is for the viola right?
what's the health thing with abuela again
what does Mrs Haddad do for work?
should I make the group chat or just text everyone separately
